user.title: Connect to AC Brain
user.description: Enter the local URL of the AC Brain controller.

data_description.url: For the local add-on this is usually http://local-kotlin-climate-brain:8080.

reconfigure.title: Update AC Brain connection
reconfigure.description: Change the local URL used to reach the AC Brain controller.

data_description.url: The controller must be reachable before the change is saved.

error.already_configured: This AC Brain controller is already configured.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The AC Brain connection was updated successfully.
